Battle Balance Lab

Seeded, headless contract trials for development—not part of the chronicle.

Ready · 32 contract-tier matchups
Fixed balance profiles: level 2 / 4 / 6 crews for Rookie / Veteran / Apex; level 10, fully awakened crews with recovered endgame gear for Echo. No consumables. Heroes use a deterministic greedy AI; hostiles use the same doctrine-aware target and movement policy as live battles.
